scope: 155 supplied environment PNGs, 12 modular platform families, editor and isolated playtest

checks: Browser decodes all 155 original PNGs at their measured sizes.
Scale control shrinks platforms and fills, enlarges chain links, preserves colliders, and supports undo/redo followed by modular extension.
Search, click and drag placement, full-canvas dimensions, default layers, independent colliders and explicit platform fitting.
Explicit JSON v1 save/reopen preserves all objects, platform families, proportional art, extended chain, tiled terrain and independent colliders.
Real StrictMode editor/playtest mount, resize, pause, restart and teardown leave one canvas and preserve campaign storage.
Real renderer uses 50% platforms, chains, fills and unique art and 200% beam modules; partial repeats crop without distortion.
Earth lands on the supplied platform surface, crosses module seams, reaches the exit and restarts without accumulating textures.

format.repository: Existing src/game/levels/data/forest-1.json is not Prettier-formatted; preserved byte-for-byte.

checks.expansionAudit: 155 PNG dimensions, alpha bounds, source hashes and 19 manifests verified; all generated data current

fullAssetAudit.detail: These original advanced sheets and their consumers were not modified. The global browser evidence fingerprint is stale; this report records only the expansion checks.

limits: No physical iPhone profiling or native build; no native changes.
Decorative slopes, stairs, magic and supports do not add new gameplay.

resizing.platforms: Uniform end caps, repeated center and cropped final module.
resizing.terrainFills: Repeat tiles in both directions at the chosen scale (default 1).
resizing.collision: Visual resizing leaves independent colliders unchanged.
resizing.compatibility: Older stretched documents render uniformly without rewriting their saved dimensions.
resizing.budgets: 4096 pieces per environment object; combined terrain/environment budget of 8192 per level.

scaling.control: Escala visual (%) uniformly scales the whole object, preserving its top-left position and module count.
scaling.extension: Subsequent width/height edits and drag extension retain the chosen module size; platform drag snaps to scaled modules.
scaling.persistence: Only two-axis environment fills need optional tileScale in JSON v1; other scales derive from dimensions. Old documents keep their appearance.
scaling.collision: Scaling leaves independent colliders unchanged; platform fitting remains explicit and undoable.
scaling.validation: Finite positive fill scales only; scaled cells respect the same 4096/8192 budgets. Fractional scales do not add phantom cells.
scaling.verification: All 167 palette entries round-trip at 10%, 25%, 50%, 150% and 200%; tested undo/redo, duplicate, save/reopen and real playtest.
